changed.title: Recover physical pins from arbitrary binary count tables on layouts with few alternating cycles
changed.statement:
∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ t : ℕ,
  let n := t+1
  let I := Fin n
  let J := Fin (n+1)
  let V := Bool × I
  let P := V → Option Bool
  let W := Fin (2*n+1)
  let inputs := 2+n*n+(n+1)*(n+1)*(2*n+1)
  let hist := fun (σ : Equiv.Perm I) (p : P) (r b : J) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (V → Bool)).filter (fun x =>
      (∀ v, p v = none ∨ p v = some (x v)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i))).card = r.val ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,σ i))).card = b.val)).card
  ∀ budget : I,
    let d := budget.val+1
    ∃ (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (flag : Fin (inputs+g.size))
      (pinWire : Bool → V → Fin (inputs+g.size)),
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs g ∧ g.size ≤ (n+2)^(C*(d+1)) ∧
      (∀ gate ∈ g.gates, ((gate.op = .and ∨ gate.op = .or) ∧ gate.inputs.length = 2) ∨
        (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1)) ∧
      ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm I), (∃ root : Fin d → I, ∀ i : I,
        ∃ a : Fin d, ∃ h : I, (σ ^ h.val) (root a) = i) →
      ∀ H : J → J → W → Bool,
        let table := fun (r b : J) => ∑ k : W, (H r b k).toNat * 2^k.val
        let permBits := (List.ofFn (fun i : I => List.ofFn (fun j : I => decide (σ i = j)))).flatten
        let countBits := (List.ofFn (fun r : J => (List.ofFn (fun b : J => List.ofFn (H r b))).flatten)).flatten
        let ws := g.wires ([false,true] ++ permBits ++ countBits)
        let q : P := fun v => if ws.getD (pinWire false v).val false then some (ws.getD (pinWire true v).val false) else none
        (ws.getD flag.val false = true ↔ ∃ p : P, hist σ p = table) ∧
          (ws.getD flag.val false = true → hist σ q = table)

changed.title: Fitting optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality on positive triples and arbitrary negatives admits relative counts at all sizes via deletion to bipartiteness
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)

let frame := fun j : Nat => j.bits.flatMap (fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false]
∃ (count : List Bool → List Bool) (d : Nat), fast count ∧
∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  let ends := fun e : Fin n × Fin n => ({e.1,e.2} : Finset (Fin n))
  let E := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)).filter (fun e => e.1 < e.2 ∧
    ∀ z ∈ neg, ¬(ends e ⊆ z.1) ∧ ¬(ends e ⊆ z.2))
  let proper := fun (X : Finset (Fin n)) (side : Fin n → Bool) =>
    ∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ∉ X → e.2 ∉ X → side e.1 ≠ side e.2
  (∀ R ∈ pos, ∀ e ∈ E, ends e ⊆ R → ∀ f ∈ E, ends f ⊆ R →
    ¬Disjoint (ends e) (ends f)) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))
  let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let size := fun f : Fn => (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin n × Fin n =>
    z.1 < z.2 ∧ obs f {z.1,z.2} ∅ = true)).card
  let hist := fun s : Nat => Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f ∧ size f = s}

  let bank := fun R : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ R))
  let input := header n ++ header pos.length ++ pos.flatMap bank ++
    header neg.length ++ neg.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2)

  ∀ (q b a : Nat), 2 ≤ b → 1 ≤ a →
    let possible := ∃ (X : Finset (Fin n)) (side : Fin n → Bool), X.card ≤ q ∧ proper X side
    let prefixBits := header q ++ header b ++ header a ++ input
    let ell := 2^(d*(q+1)) * (prefixBits.length+2)^d
    let out := fun tape : Fin ell → Bool => count (prefixBits ++ List.ofFn tape)
    (∀ tape, out tape = [] ↔ ¬possible) ∧
    (possible → ∃ (X : Finset (Fin n)) (side : Fin n → Bool),
      X.card ≤ q ∧ proper X side ∧
      ∃ z : (Fin ell → Bool) → Fin (n/2+1) → Nat,
        (∀ tape, out tape = bank X ++ List.ofFn side ++
          (List.finRange (n/2+1)).flatMap (fun s => frame (z tape s))) ∧
        (∀ tape s, z tape s = 0 ↔ hist s.val = 0) ∧
        2^a * Nat.card {tape : Fin ell → Bool // ∀ s : Fin (n/2+1),
          (4*b-4)*hist s.val ≤ z tape s ∧ z tape s ≤ (4*b+4)*hist s.val} ≥ (2^a-1)*2^ell)

changed.title: All joint size and signed-score counts of optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions modulo a power of two admit one deterministic machine
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let bits := fun (w z : Nat) => (List.range w).map (fun h => z.testBit h)
let pairs := fun k : Nat => (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i =>
    ((List.finRange k).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))
∃ (M : Turing.TM2ComputableAux Bool Bool) (c : Nat), (∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)) ∧
∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (hard : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)))
    (soft : List ((Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)) × Bool)),
  let m := soft.length
  let ends := fun e : Fin n × Fin n => ({e.1,e.2} : Finset (Fin n))
  let E := (pairs n).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    ∀ z ∈ hard, ¬(ends e ⊆ z.1) ∧ ¬(ends e ⊆ z.2))
  let lists := fun (S : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (t : (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)) × Bool) =>
    Disjoint t.1.1 t.1.2 ∧ ∀ e ∈ S, ends e ⊆ t.1.1 ∨ ends e ⊆ t.1.2
  (∀ S ⊆ E, 2 ≤ S.card →
    (∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, e ≠ f → Disjoint (ends e) (ends f)) →
    (soft.filter (fun t => t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length =
      (soft.filter (fun t => !t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R T : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ T))
  let valid := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    ∀ z ∈ hard, obs f z.1 z.2 = false
  let code := fun f : Fn => (pairs n).map (fun e => obs f (ends e) ∅)
  let size := fun f : Fn => ((code f).filter id).length
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (obs f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length
  let bank := fun B : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ B))
  let input := header n ++ header hard.length ++ hard.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2) ++
    header m ++ soft.flatMap (fun t => bank t.1.1 ++ bank t.1.2 ++ [t.2])
  ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k →
    let x := header k ++ input
    let count := fun s j : Nat => Nat.card {f : Fn // valid f ∧ size f = s ∧ score f = j}
    let output := (List.range (n/2+1)).flatMap (fun s =>
      (List.range (m+1)).flatMap (fun j => bits k (count s j % 2^k)))
    Nonempty (Turing.TM2OutputsInTime M.tm (x.map M.inputAlphabet.invFun)
      (some (output.map M.outputAlphabet.invFun)) ((x.length+2)^(c*(k+1))))
